description.value: Seven Stones Estate Winery sits on a sun-drenched bench overlooking the Similkameen Valley and is known for bold red wines aged in underground cave cellars carved into the hillside. Founded by winemaker George Hanson, the estate practices sustainable viticulture and small-lot winemaking, earning recognition for blends like the award-winning Legend. Cyclists on the Crowsnest Highway can stop for a tasting, explore the cave tours, and take in panoramic vineyard views from the patio.
